svg.title: How Kerala addresses two distinct care problems
svg.desc: After a property transfer: Some families accept an asset and then neglect the older giver.. Policy under consideration: Officials considered reversing transfers where care was withheld.. Abandoned visitors: A separate effort reconnects people with their home regions.

g.text: How Kerala addresses two distinct care problems
Some families accept an asset and then neglect the older giver.
Officials considered reversing transfers where care was withheld.
A separate effort reconnects people with their home regions.
